nav.footerTagline: Commerce tools for modern stores. Home of Shoppio — AI shopping for WooCommerce.

hero.title: {name}
hero.body: Our first product is {product} — an AI shopping assistant for WooCommerce. Customers ask questions, discover products, and get recommendations through conversation.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.intro: Full documentation is coming soon. For now, here is the essential path to get {product} running.
docs.step1Body: Sign up for {name} and follow the guided onboarding to connect your first store with {product}.
docs.step2Body: Install {product} on your WooCommerce site, then connect using the instructions shown during onboarding. API secrets stay on your WordPress server — never in the browser.
docs.step3Body: Once connected, {product} syncs your catalog so the storefront assistant can recommend real products with prices and images.
